DJI.note: DPCS Foresight is a port logistics forecasting initiative, not stated as AI in service in a government body's administration.

facts.fact: La Nation, relaying a World Bank course case study, says DPCS Foresight uses AI and historical logistics data to develop forecasting and decision-support capacity for port and logistics actors, presented as an evolution of DPCS and not as a service in use.

systems.owner: Autorite des Ports et des Zones Franches de Djibouti (DPFZA)

DJI.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or AI computing stated.

facts.fact: La Nation, relaying a World Bank course case study, says Djibouti Port Community Systems combines a port community system and a Maritime Single Window in one platform linking port authorities, customs services, terminal operators, shipping lines, forwarders, free zones and hauliers, set up on a 2017 presidential instruction to the DPFZA for a single electronic platform for foreign trade formalities.

systems.platform: port community system and Maritime Single Window
systems.owner: Autorite des Ports et des Zones Franches de Djibouti (DPFZA)

DJI.note: Mentions Djibouti-Ethiopia corridor information sharing, but names no agreement, shared facility or Ethiopian body.
